mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper_account_balance ( account_no, base_datetime, cash_balance, available_cash, total_asset_amount, total_evaluation_amount, total_profit_loss_amount, total_profit_loss_rate ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{baseDatetime}, #{cashBalance}, #{availableCash}, #{totalAssetAmount}, #{totalEvaluationAmount}, #{totalProfitLossAmount}, #{totalProfitLossRate} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_no, base_datetime, cash_balance, available_cash, total_asset_amount, total_evaluation_amount, total_profit_loss_amount, total_profit_loss_rate, created_at FROM paper_account_balance WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY base_datetime DESC, id DESC LIMIT 2
